name: unsafe fn spawn_unchecked < F , T > (self , f : F) -> io :: Result < JoinHandle < T > > where F : FnOnce () -> T , F : Send , T : Send ,
rule: The caller must ensure that the thread spawned by `Builder::spawn_unchecked` does not outlive any references in the supplied closure `f` or its return type `T`. This may be guaranteed by calling `JoinHandle::join` before any referenced data is dropped, or by using only types with `'static` lifetime bounds—types containing no references or only `'static` references—for both `f` and `T`.
